Following the success of Mouthwashing, Swedish developer Wrong Organ is releasing a new co-op title. The game features claustrophobic tank combat with a supernatural twist.

item.title: Marvel Tōkon: Fighting Souls Review
item.description:
Arc System Works' new superhero-themed fighter offers impressive visuals and accessible controls. The game evolves the anime-style fighting formula with a low-floor, high-ceiling approach for players.
